names.note: Read out of saint.gr’s heading «Αγία Χαριτίνη».
Read out of doxologia.ro’s line „Sfânta Muceniță Haritina” for 5 octombrie.
The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2747, «Харитина Амисийская (Понтийская), мц.», with the rank word left off and the parenthesised second form of the place left to this note.

death.note: saint.gr heads its entry «Αγια Χαριτινη (; - 304)» and says: «Το 304 μ.Χ. κάποιοι την κατήγγειλαν». doxologia.ro sets her under Diocletian and prints no year. The Greek 4 September entry, which is the same saint (the author’s ruling of 2 October 2026), supposes instead that she may have been martyred at Trajan’s passing through Ephesus on his way to the Persian war, two centuries earlier; it supposes it from the company her memory is kept in and states no year, so 304 stands as the only year either calendar prints and the supposition is in the life.

source.note: The rank is the alt text of the icon the page sets before the day's first line, which is this one: «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — a service the Typikon marks with no sign at all. The day's one higher rank belongs to the synaxis of the hierarchs of Moscow, which follows.

attestations.note: The year agrees with saint.gr's 304. The Russian index of names gives her a city the Greek entry does not, and gives it twice over: «Харитина Амисийская (Понтийская), мц.» — of Amisus, of Pontus. The same day keeps a second Charitina, the princess of Lithuania who died in 1281, and the page distinguishes them by title alone, «мц.» against «прп.» The same day line keeps a second and different Charitina — «Прп. Харитины, кн. Литовской, в Новгороде подвизавшейся (1281)», the Lithuanian princess who struggled at Novgorod. She is not this saint, is not in the Ohrid Prologue, and has no folder; dedupe on the date finds them both on this day and the name is what would conflate them.

feast.note: The Romanian calendar keeps her on this day only: she is not on doxologia.ro’s list for 4 septembrie, where the Greek synaxarion keeps her too (checked 2026-08-23).

The second Greek day, kept with Petronius and with Hermione and Eutychis the daughters of the apostle Philip. Its entry carries the same verse as the 5 October entry and itself asks whether the two Charitinas are one; the author ruled on 2 October 2026 that they are, and this record is the merge of the two folders the corpus held.
First of the four the Ohrid Prologue enumerates for this day, and much the fullest of them. Its account of her contest is longer than either of the other two calendars’.

source.text: Охридски пролог, 5. октобар ст. к. — «1. Св. муч. Харитина. Као сироче у детињству би посвојена од некога угледна човека и хришћанина Клаудија, који је васпита као своју рођену кћер.»

hymns.text: Θεία χάριτι, κραταιωθεῖσα, κράτος ἤσχυνας, τῆς δυσσεβείας, Χαριτίνη ὑπὲρ φύσιν ἀθλήσασα ὅθεν χαρίτων πηγὴν ἀδαπάνητον, ὡς γλυκασμὸν ἀναβλύζεις τοὶς κράζουσι. Μάρτυς ἔνδοξε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν ἱκέτευε, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Αγία Χαριτίνη, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: Strengthened by divine grace, thou didst put to shame the might of impiety, O Charitina, contending beyond nature; wherefore thou pourest forth an unfailing fountain of graces, as sweetness, for those who cry out. O glorious martyr, entreat Christ God to grant us great mercy.

hymns.text: Mieluşeaua Ta, Iisuse, Haritina, strigă cu glas mare: pe Tine, Mirele meu, te iubesc și pe Tine căutându-Te mă chinuiesc și împreună mă răstignesc și împreună mă îngrop cu Botezul Tău; și pătimesc pentru Tine, ca să împărățesc întru Tine; și mor pentru tine, ca să viez pentru Tine; ci, ca o jertfă fără de prihană, primește-mă pe mine ceea ce cu dragoste mă jertfesc Ție. Pentru rugăciunile ei, ca un Milostiv, mântuiește sufletele noastre.

english.text: Thy ewe-lamb, O Jesus, Charitina, crieth with a loud voice: Thee, my Bridegroom, do I love, and seeking thee I suffer; I am crucified and buried with thee in thy baptism, and I suffer for thy sake, that I may reign in thee; I die for thee, that I may also live with thee. But as a spotless sacrifice accept me, who am offered to thee with love. Through her prayers, since thou art merciful, save our souls.

hymns.text: Pentru dragostea Domnului, Sfântă Preamărită Haritina, suferind toate cele îngrozitoare ale chinurilor, ai câştigat cununa muceniciei cea nestricăcioasă.

english.text: For the love of the Lord, O holy and most glorious Charitina, enduring all the terrors of the torments, thou hast won the incorruptible crown of martyrdom.

hymns.text: Întărindu-te la minte, Sfântă Muceniţă Haritina, ţi-ai întărit sufletul cu cre­dinţa; biruind pe vrăjmaşi aie­vea i-ai ruşinat, stând înaintea lui Hristos întru tot fericită; şi acum, purtând haină din sân­gele tău şi cu îngerii bucurându-te, roagă-te pentru noi, pur­tătoare de chinuri.

english.text: Strengthened in mind, O holy martyr Charitina, thou didst make thy soul strong with faith; overcoming the enemies, thou didst put them openly to shame, standing all-blessed before Christ; and now, clothed in a garment of thy blood and rejoicing with the angels, pray for us, O passion-bearer.
